verdict.rationale: Yubico's SSH guides document generating non-exportable SSH keys directly on the YubiKey with OpenSSH via FIDO2. Every cryptographic operation requires user presence (a touch), with optional PIN. A hands-on community report confirms ed25519 FIDO SSH keys work, and docs plus community confirm PIV (PKCS#11) and OpenPGP smartcard key storage. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of SSH via the PIV/OpenPGP paths, and evidence of touch-policy enforcement on those applets.
